claude_proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken.count
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell text says 'A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.' This per-turn cap on activations of the damage reduction is not expressible on the current reduce_damage_taken atom. The parallel field on modify_roll_numeric (count: number) directly covers this pattern.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.
